events.description: RED ROOM | July 24 Enter the darkness. BLACK ROOM returns to M2 Miami's Chamber Room for RED ROOM an immersive night of hypnotic techno and hardgroove, we will have a strict No Phone Policy designed to keep every moment on the dancefloor. Experience a carefully curated lineup featuring: Carbon Nerve Javier Almenares The Red Noise (ARG) Marcelo Mori Expect deep, driving energy, immersive production, and an intimate atmosphere where the music comes first. No Phone Policy Be present. Dance freely. Live the moment. Limited capacity. Secure your tickets before prices increase. Welcome to RED ROOM. July 24th, 2026 M2 Miami [Chamber Room] Physical ID required No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia, or hate of any kind. All ticket sales are final. No refunds. Contact: info@blackroom.live or DM @blackroom.us
